messages:
mara: Heads-up — Helios Systems hit a blocker on the private deployment path. Their on‑prem GPU nodes are behind a strict perimeter firewall and the marketplace installer fails during model download / KV cache warmup. Customer wants go‑live next Tue. Can we get a quick architecture review + escalation plan? @tiago can you triage?

tiago: On it. Can you drop the install logs and the privateimage config here?

mara: Gist: https://gist.redwood/helios-deploy-logs (config + error snippets). Important bits: TLS handshake failures to model-store.svc.cluster.local and repeated 504s from the cache warmer.

tiago: Quick scan — TLS handshake + SNI mismatch looks likely. Also seeing cert chain errors: issuer CN not in allowed CA list. Could also be firewall killing long streams. @sam (eng-infra) any constraints on privateimage CA and firewall rules?

sam: For private marketplace installs we require outbound to: 8443/tcp (control), 9090/tcp (model store), and 6000-6010/tcp for workers (ephemeral). Also need 53/udp for DNS to customer resolver. Add these to their perimeter ACLs. Example snippet for ops: ```
# allow outbound to Redwood model endpoints
ALLOW TCP 10.0.0.0/8:8443 -> model-store.redwood.net:8443
ALLOW TCP 10.0.0.0/8:9090 -> model-store.redwood.net:9090
ALLOW TCP 10.0.0.0/8:6000-6010 -> worker-pool.redwood.net:6000-6010
```

josh: Another angle — the model they picked is our quantized 4-bit variant. We've seen kernel mismatches on older driver stacks (NVIDIA 470-ish). Runtime shows AVX+ kernel fallback failing which manifests as handshake/timeouts during cache warmup. Recommend either upgrading drivers to >=525 or falling back to fp16 model. FP16 will work on older drivers but expect 2-3x token latency.

helena (Helios): Ops currently on driver 470, upgrading to 525 requires maintenance window and approval. Can Redwood provide a fallback fp16 variant we can test asap? Also worried about cert rotation cadence — our security team wants explicit fingerprints.

anya: We can stage a canary: route 10% traffic to fp16 fallback and enable KV cache warming for 30m pre‑cutover. I can own the rollout doc and the canary checklist. For certs: we need the CA fingerprint and a short rotation plan.

mara: Owners: tiago -> runbook + logs, sam -> firewall/registry config, josh -> model fallback plan, anya -> canary + rollout doc, helena -> coordination with Helios ops. Can we schedule a 40min arch review at 16:00 PST today?

helena (Helios): 16:00 PST works. Sharing Helios preflight checklist below:
```
Helios preflight checklist:
- CA fingerprint: sha256:AB:CD:... (will send full)
- Open ports: 8443, 9090, 6000-6010, DNS outbound
- Driver: currently 470 (upgrade request in flight)
- Disk: /var/lib/redwood >= 120GB free
- Service account: cluster-admin for installer (temporary)
```

tiago: I'll draft the runbook snippet and push to repo: https://repo.redwood/ops/helios-runbooks — will include rollback steps and a network test command: ```curl -v https://model-store.redwood.net:9090/healthz --resolve model-store.redwood.net:9090:198.51.100.12```

incident-bot: Created ticket INT-7921 (Helios integration escalation). Assigned to tiago and sam.

mara: Great — thanks everyone. We'll take the call at 16:00 PST and aim to have a canary plan by EOD. If anything urgent pops up before the call, ping me + @anya. :thumbsup:
